labels.name: Tibia
labels.function: Primary weight-bearing bone; transmits force from knee to foot

labels.name: Tibialis anterior
labels.function: Main dorsiflexor; also helps invert the foot

labels.name: Deep fibular nerve
labels.function: Supplies dorsiflexors; sensation to the first dorsal web space

labels.name: Extensor digitorum longus
labels.function: Lifts digits 2-5 and dorsiflexes; aids toe clearance

labels.name: Interosseous membrane
labels.function: Sheet joining the leg bones; walls off front from back muscles

labels.name: Superficial fibular nerve
labels.function: Supplies evertors; sensation to most of the dorsum of the foot

labels.name: Fibularis longus
labels.function: Everts; tendon crosses the sole to support the transverse arch

labels.name: Fibula
labels.function: Bears little weight; muscle attachment and ankle stability

labels.name: Gastrocnemius
labels.function: Crosses knee and ankle; plantarflexes and flexes the knee

labels.name: Soleus
labels.function: Acts only at the ankle; key for standing posture

labels.name: Tibial nerve
labels.function: Supplies plantarflexors and toe flexors; continues to the sole

labels.name: Tibialis posterior
labels.function: Powerful inverter; dynamic support of the medial arch

labels.name: Medial malleolus
labels.function: Bony inner wall of the ankle mortise; tunnel lies behind it

labels.name: Tibialis posterior tendon
labels.function: Tom: front of the line; inverts and supports the medial arch

labels.name: Flexor digitorum longus tendon
labels.function: Dick: second in line; flexes digits 2-5

labels.name: Posterior tibial artery
labels.function: And: third in line, the arterial vessel

labels.name: Posterior tibial veins
labels.function: Very: fourth in line, paired return vessels

labels.name: Tibial nerve
labels.function: Nervous: compressed in tarsal tunnel syndrome; sole numbness

labels.name: Flexor hallucis longus tendon
labels.function: Harry: last in line; propulsion through the great toe

labels.name: Flexor retinaculum
labels.function: Fibrous roof that closes the tunnel over these contents

labels.name: Calcaneal tendon
labels.function: Carries triceps surae force to the heel; Thompson test if torn

labels.name: Femoral nerve
accept: anterior cutaneous branches of the femoral nerve
anterior cutaneous nerves of the thigh
labels.function: Anterior thigh skin; one long sensory branch reaches the foot

labels.name: Obturator nerve
labels.function: Only a small patch of medial thigh skin

labels.name: Common fibular nerve
labels.function: Winds around the neck of the lateral leg bone; foot drop if hurt

labels.name: Saphenous nerve
labels.function: Purely sensory; medial leg down to the medial side of the foot

labels.name: Superficial fibular nerve
labels.function: Most of the dorsum of the foot; motor to the evertors

labels.name: Deep fibular nerve
labels.function: Only the first dorsal web space; motor to the dorsiflexors

labels.name: Sural nerve
labels.function: Posterolateral leg and lateral border of the foot

labels.name: Tibial nerve
labels.function: Sole of the foot via two plantar branches; lost in tarsal tunnel
